about.title: A senior consultant, not a technology salesperson.
paragraphs: For over fifteen years I have helped companies and investors manage energy: from the first consumption analysis to contract negotiation and energy plan governance.

I work independently, with no commissions from suppliers or installers. My only interest is a measurable result for the client: every recommendation is backed by data, models and a clear return estimate.
I focus on complex contexts — multi-site portfolios, energy-intensive industrial processes, and M&A deals with a material energy component.

faq.title: Answers you need before we start
faq.subtitle: If you can't find your question, just write: I reply personally.

items.question: How long does an engagement take?
items.answer: It depends on the goal. An initial diagnosis takes 2–3 weeks; a full efficiency project can span 6–18 months, with periodic follow-ups and savings verification.

items.question: Do you only work in Italy?
items.answer: No. I have worked in 12 countries and support clients with assets in different jurisdictions, remotely and with dedicated on-site missions where needed.

items.question: How is the fee structured?
items.answer: Fixed fee, success fee or a mix of the two. No hidden commissions: the economics are always shared before we start.

items.question: Do you replace my energy manager?
items.answer: No. I act as a senior reinforcement: I work alongside the internal team, bring method and technical capability, then transfer the skills.

items.question: Do you handle the paperwork for incentives too?
items.answer: Yes: identification, application, reporting and liaison with authorities, both national and European.
